positions.title: Interim Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked on a team that was responsible for a web application that tracks phone crashes in an automated testing environment
•	Designed and implemented a REST API for the crash tracking web application
•	Set up buildbot to automatically test and deploy changes when they are detected in the code repository
•	Set up Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana stack to parse, structure, and index log data to allow quick and powerful analysis
•	Refactored code for increased maintainability and performance

positions.title: Test Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Automated an electromagnetic compatibility test station by writing software in Visual Basic and interfacing a test console with a spectrum analyzer and a signal generator
•	Reduced test time by 83% from 60 minutes to 10 minutes
•	Increased accuracy and consistency by eliminating human error
•	Created logging software in Visual Basic for tracking product status throughout production and testing
